sanskrit_verse:
लेख्यं त्रिंशत् समातीतम् अदृष्टाश्रावितं च यत् ।
न तत्सिद्धिमवाप्नोति तिष्ठत्स्वपि हि साक्षिषु ॥
transliteration: lekhyaṃ triṃśat samātītam adṛṣṭāśrāvitaṃ ca yat | na tatsiddhim avāpnoti tiṣṭhatsv api hi sākṣiṣu ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Any written document or testimony that has not been witnessed or verified within thirty samas does not attain validity even if witnesses are present.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from active witnessing, not mere presence.
Causation requires temporal alignment with conscious observation.
Capacity-based responsibility includes the duty to timely validate truth.
Restoration logic demands reconnection with the living witness of dharma.
Consciousness alignment necessitates synchronization with the rhythm of samas.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a document or testimony exceeds thirty samas without active witnessing THEN its evidentiary value is nullified.
IF witnesses exist BUT have not actively attested within the prescribed time THEN no judicial validity accrues.
ALL legal assertions MUST align with the witnessed continuum of sākshi-consciousness.
TEMPORAL proximity to conscious verification determines admissibility in dharma-adjudication.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, documents or testimonies beyond thirty samas without verified witnessing shall be excluded from consideration. The threshold of responsibility lies in the capacity of the witness to affirm within the dharmic timeframe. Authority flows only through that which is seen and heard in alignment with cosmic rhythm.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that un-witnessed assertions lack foundational support. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that delay in witnessing disrupts sequential manifestation of truth. Proportional responsibility rests with those who neglect timely validation. The non-punitive reality rule affirms that invalid evidence naturally dissolves when unmoored from sākshi-consciousness.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process by requiring fresh witnessing within prescribed time.
Engage responsible parties in assuming accountability for delayed validation.
Restore capacity by reconnecting individuals with the practice of immediate affirmation.
Reintegrate integrity through ceremonial reaffirmation before qualified sākshis.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: no testimony transcends the boundary of thirty samas without conscious witnessing. Dharma is restored through alignment with sākshi-tattva. Reality remains non-punitive, ever guided by the Supreme Consciousness as the ultimate Adjudicator.
